item.title: 🟠 Unpatched XRING Flaw in XQUIC Lets Remote Clients Crash HTTP/3 Servers
item.description:

item.title: 🟠 Attackers Exploit 'Ill Bloom' Vulnerability to Drain Over $5 Million From Cryptocurrency Wallets
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.

The flaw is in how some wallet software generated its recovery phrase, the words that control the money.
